Ghosts of Glen returns with new route, haunted history tours in Glen Carbon (https://www.theintelligencer.com/news/article/ghosts-of-glen-tour-glen-carbon-il-22463669.php)
【turn46news32】 [wordlim: 100] Published: today; The annual "Ghosts of Glen" tour in Glen Carbon returns for its fifth year, commencing on October 9 and continuing on October 10, 23, and 24. Organized by the Glen Carbon Heritage Museum, the tour begins at 7 p.m. from the museum at 124 School St. and traverses through Old Town, featuring chilling tales, local legends, and paranormal mysteries. Attendees can use real paranormal investigation tools and learn about the village’s haunted history. Due to Main Street construction, the 2026 tour follows a new route with fresh stories and stops. While the usual halfway stop at the library has been removed, participants can enjoy hot cocoa and cookies at the museum before the tour begins. Each event lasts around three hours and occurs rain or shine, except in cases of thunderstorms. Museum Manager Samantha Doolin launched the tour in 2022 in collaboration with the Glen Carbon Library, and it has grown to four tour dates annually, each accommodating 38 participants. Working alongside the Midwest Paranormal Investigators' Consortium, the tour offers a unique combination of storytelling and hands-on ghost hunting. Tickets cost $25 and can be purchased via Eventbrite or directly at the museum.

Halloween fun across Manistee, Benzie (https://www.manisteenews.com/news/article/guide-halloween-events-manistee-benzie-counties-22465109.php)
【turn46news33】 [wordlim: 100] Published: yesterday; Throughout October, Manistee and Benzie counties in Michigan are offering a diverse range of Halloween-themed events for all ages. Activities include spooky film screenings such as “The Addams Family” at the Vogue Theatre, dramatic one-act plays by local high school students, and the Ghost Ship haunted experience aboard a historic car ferry featuring live actors and special effects. Crystal Mountain Resort will host its annual Scarecrow Walk, and the Grand Traverse Band of Ottawa and Chippewa Indians will present a carnival for children. Adults can participate in haunted library events, horror trivia, or historical ghost storytelling. Additional highlights include potion-making science exhibits, costume contests, trunk-or-treat events across various towns, and Halloween art classes. Many events are free or low-cost, and registration is encouraged for select programs. Halloween day itself boasts numerous activities, including trick-or-treating, book fairs, haunted museum tours, and a high-prize costume contest. The complete schedule reflects a community-wide embrace of Halloween, offering entertainment that ranges from eerie and thrilling to creative and family-friendly.

【turn46news42】 [wordlim: 100] Published: last month; Freeform's annual "31 Nights of Halloween" returns for October 2026, offering a full month of spooky-themed programming. The schedule features Halloween classics including Hocus Pocus, Casper, The Addams Family, The Nightmare Before Christmas, and Ghostbusters films. Highlights include a Tim Burton marathon on October 16 and the Freeform premiere of Ghostbusters: Frozen Empire (2024) on October 8. A notable addition is the debut of the teen drama series Coven Academy, created by Tim Federle, which follows three young witches at a prestigious magical school. The show premieres on October 1 and will be available for streaming the next day on Disney+, Hulu, and Freeform On Demand. Throughout the month, viewers can enjoy a mix of family-friendly favorites and chilling thrillers, such as Beetlejuice, Maleficent, Sleepy Hollow, and Scooby-Doo series. The programming culminates on Halloween day with festive staples including Casper, Hocus Pocus, and Frankenweenie. All showings are subject to change.
